title: Canonical hover exception (compiler Task 1)
description: A review-gated page-local override of a full-carrier binding. It pins the canonical payload identity against which the exception was reviewed and may name a replacement payload. Mutable review_status and private notes are excluded from exception identity. Dry-run; source-clean.
migration: @2 requires reviewed_against_canonical_payload_id and adds it to immutable exception review provenance; mutable review_status remains outside exception identity. The coordinated binding identity field change causes one intentional binding-id churn because ids are content-addressed over the new field set; canonical_wbw_loc remains load-bearing in those binding ids. Existing @1 sample fixtures remain valid history and are not rewritten.
